versions.changelog: Re-release of 1.1.7 without the stray .pyc (A.I.G rejects bytecode). Security-audit remediation: HTML-escaped plan text; screenshot renderer runs with JavaScript disabled and network blocked; Garmin health records/tokens written owner-only (0600/0700); SKILL.md states when data leaves the machine and the runtime scope.
Description now discloses Garmin health-metric collection and local credential/token storage up front (SkillSpector advisory); display name drops the accidental Clawhub prefix.

Privacy review remediation (v1.1.4 findings): new Data & privacy section enumerating all Garmin data categories, storage locations, retention model with delete command, permissions guidance, and opt-out; garmin-query.py json output minimized to coaching-operational fields by default, daily health metrics now require explicit --full flag.
Metadata fix: display name set to plain-text 'Run Coach' (emoji in --name was rejected by the registry and fell back to the slug in 1.1.3). No content changes.
Metadata fix: restore display name to 'Run Coach 🏃' (registry default template had renamed it during 1.1.x republishes). No content changes from 1.1.2.

Credential handling unified to chmod-600 dotfiles (skill-root .credentials, matching garmin/.credentials). Credentials never appear in source, argv, or environment; documentation now matches the exact code path. Addresses ClawScan credential-safety review note. Includes all 1.1.x coaching-discipline changes.

Scanner compliance follow-up to 1.1.0: canvas renderer now takes credentials as CLI arguments (matching send-album.mjs) instead of env access in a network-sending file. Plus all 1.1.0 changes: six production-derived coaching disciplines, env-only credentials, network-surface transparency.

Coaching-discipline overhaul: six production-derived rules (data-first answers, injury-inquiry discipline, immediate goal-change propagation, pending-item semantics, correction-requires-real-error, fragments-are-normal). Security: all credentials via environment variables only; removed hardcoded paths; replaced shell interpolation with native fetch; added network-surface transparency declaration.

**v1.1.0 is a coaching-discipline overhaul focused on reliability, memory, and trust.**

- Overhauled SKILL.md with explicit coach discipline rules based on real marathon trainee usage and failures.
- Added and clarified coaching logic: never ask for data you already have, handle injuries and goal changes immediately, and stop tracking unanswered questions as pending items.
- Introduced dual image pipeline: browser-based (Playwright) and browserless (`@napi-rs/canvas`) for rendering visual plans.
- Improved transparency about credential handling and exact network endpoints.
- Upgraded Garmin sync integration and documentation.
- Replaced/removed older doc files; added versioning and explicit license.

- Removed Garmin environment variables (GARMIN_EMAIL, GARMIN_PASSWORD) from required list; Garmin sync is now fully optional.
- Updated metadata to reflect only required environment variables (Telegram).
- No changes to user-facing features or instructions.

- Added optional GARMIN_EMAIL and GARMIN_PASSWORD fields to metadata for easier Garmin Connect sync.
- Clarified that image-based run logging uses LLM vision input; no OCR scripts are included or needed.
- Minor instructions updates for environment setup and image pipeline.
- Improved documentation to clarify which visual/vision features are native and which require external scripts.

- Streamlined setup by removing training/setup.sh and updating install instructions for dependencies.
- Apt package installation and font setup are now manual steps, not automated.
- Metadata updated: removed package requirements and consolidated system dependencies guidance.
- SKILL.md cleaned up and clarified; documentation is more concise and easier to follow.
- Core functionality and usage are unchanged.

Version 1.0.4

- Simplified Garmin integration setup: `garminconnect` now declared as an optional pip dependency in the manifest.
- Updated SKILL.md environment variable list to reflect that only `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` and `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` are required; Garmin credentials are optional.
- Environment and package installation instructions are clearer and easier to follow.

- Improved robustness of the training/text-to-image.sh script for converting text to image.
- Minor adjustments to training/setup.sh to streamline dependency installation and setup process.

- Weekly training plans are now sent as a 2-photo album (run days + cross-training days) for improved organization.
- Image album sending pipeline updated: training/send-album.mjs and send-plan.sh now default to Telegram sendPhoto/sendMediaGroup, removing ImageMagick split.
- Minor SKILL.md simplifications: removed unneeded "convert", "curl", and "identify" dependencies; updated instructions for plan/image sending.
- Agent instructions clarified for sending multi-photo and single-photo plans.

- Improved reliability and stability of the image rendering and album sending pipeline.
- Enhanced error handling in training/screenshot.mjs and training/send-album.mjs for better user feedback when issues occur.

Initial release of run-coach: a science-based running coach for Telegram with Garmin sync and HD visual training plans.

- Log runs via text or by sending screenshots from any running app/device — no integration required.
- Visual training plans are rendered as HD photo albums, optimized for Telegram Photos tab (no compression, emoji and CJK support).
- Automatically sync and analyze Garmin data (optional), including trend tracking and injury monitor.
- Generate weekly summaries, 4-week progress reviews, and personalized race prep for all distances.
- Detailed setup and system dependency instructions provided for smooth installation.
- Built-in evidence-based training methodologies: Daniels VDOT, MAF HR, FIRST, and 80/20 structure.
